ideas.title: +1 Stealth Per Step 🔦
ideas.hook: Every step you take in the prison yard gives +1 Stealth. Stealth shrinks the guards' flashlight cones, so the more you sneak, the further you can push toward the outer wall before a light catches you.
core_loop: Sneak out of your cell block; each step adds +1 Stealth
Slip past searchlights and patrolling guards toward the next fence
Get spotted and you're dragged back to the cell, keeping your Stealth
Rebirth after each wall you clear for a stealth multiplier and a new, bigger prison
ideas.twist: Stealth is also your speed limit: sprinting drains it, so you choose between slow and invisible or fast and loud.
retention: Rebirth into harder prisons (desert, island, space)
Daily lockdown event with double guards and double Stealth
ideas.why_now: Escape / run jumped 0.81 this week to 1.42 momentum ([🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 45.7K CCU, +1 Spider Arm🕷️ 23.5K), +1 stat per action is at 2.39 (up 0.28; [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 36.3K) and Prison / police rose 0.36 to 1.12 (Punch to Escape! 👊 4.8K, 🥟SQUISHY DUMPLING PRISON RUN! (Obby) 4.6K).
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Prison games are about digging or punching out. Here the +1 grind itself is the escape tool: your stat literally shrinks the lights.

ideas.title: Launch Into a Giant's Pocket 👖
ideas.hook: A giant strolls past your slingshot. Fling yourself as a ragdoll and try to land in his pockets: shirt pocket, jeans, backpack. Each pocket holds loot by rarity, and the giant never stops walking.
core_loop: Pull back the slingshot and aim at the walking giant
Ragdoll through the air and hope to land in a pocket
Grab the loot inside (coins, keys, rare trinkets) before you fall out
Upgrade slingshot power and grip; unlock bigger giants
ideas.twist: Pockets move with every step, so timing beats raw power. Bounce off his shoulder for bonus distance.
retention: Index of pocket trinkets with secret items
New giant every week (chef, astronaut, king)
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.42 (up 0.27; [🎃] Throw Food For Animals 129.7K, Ragdoll Reality 🩸 31.1K) and Giant / huge jumped 0.88 to 1.70 (Durian Garden 🍈 27.5K, Raise The Biggest Family 14.9K). Physics Sim is steady at 2.10 ([🎃] Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 23.0K).
ideas.differentiator: Launch games aim at a static target or distance. Here the target is a moving giant, and every pocket is its own loot table.

ideas.title: +1 Planet Size 🪐
ideas.hook: You are a tiny planet. Every asteroid you swallow gives +1 Size, and bigger planets pull in bigger rocks, moons and finally whole stars.
core_loop: Drift through space and swallow asteroids for +1 Size
Size up to pull in moons, comets and space junk
Collect rare cores to fill your planet index
Rebirth into a new galaxy with a gravity multiplier
ideas.twist: Other players are planets too. Get big enough and you can pull a smaller player into orbit as your moon, sharing their gains.
retention: Galaxy rebirths with new rock types
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.39, up 0.28 this week ([🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 36.3K, [🌍UPD] +1 Anime Eyes 34.6K), and Space rose 0.52 to 1.56 ([🎃] Clean the Moon! 5.3K, +1 Slinky Escape 4.3K). Hub + zone maps are at 1.58.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a body part or a stat bar; here you are the planet, and growing changes what the world gets pulled toward you.

ideas.title: Chase the Runaway ATM 🏧
ideas.hook: An ATM grew legs and bolted down the street. Chase it through a course of traffic, fences and rooftops, and every hit you land makes it spit out cash.
core_loop: The ATM sprints off down a hazard course
Chase it, dodging cars and jumping gaps
Smack it with your bat to knock cash loose and pick it up
Upgrade speed and bat; later ATMs are faster and drop more
ideas.twist: Hit it too hard and it spins out and runs faster, so steady hits beat big swings.
monetization: Magnet pass to grab dropped cash
retention: New ATM types (vault, piggy bank, slot machine) weekly
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is up 0.81 to 1.42 ([🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 45.7K, +1 Spider Arm🕷️ 23.5K), Money / rich is at 2.21 and up 0.16 ([🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 46.7K, [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 45.7K), and linear courses lead map styles at 2.17 (DONT SPLASH 81.5K).
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Runners make you flee. Here you are the chaser and the loot runs away, which flips the escape loop.

ideas.title: Grow a Volcano 🌋
ideas.hook: Plant a volcano seed on your plot and keep it hot. It grows taller each hour, then erupts and rains lava rocks you crack open for gems.
core_loop: Plant volcano seeds of different rarity
Feed them heat (coal, fire crystals) to grow
Trigger an eruption and catch the lava rocks
Crack rocks for gems, sell, buy rarer seeds
ideas.twist: Neighbours can cool your volcano with water balloons to stall it, so you guard your plot while it grows.
retention: Seed index (ice volcano, rainbow volcano, secret)
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is steady and high-confidence at 1.16 (Durian Garden 🍈 27.5K, [🎃] Steal a Forest 5.7K) and Ice / fire / elements is at 1.39, up 0.12 (Firefighting Sim 🚒 9.4K). Break / mine / dig is at 2.0 but low confidence (Break and Steal an Egg holds most of it), so it is only the side ingredient here.
ideas.differentiator: Grow games harvest calm crops. Here the crop is a disaster you trigger, and the payout comes from cracking what it throws.

ideas.title: Run a Knight School 🛡️
ideas.hook: Build a training yard, recruit peasant students, and turn them into knights. Graduates go on quests and send gold back to your school.
core_loop: Recruit students and place training stations (dummies, archery, horses)
Students train on their own and level up
Graduate them into knight classes and send them on quests
Spend quest gold on bigger yards and rarer classes
ideas.twist: Rare students roll random traits (clumsy, giant, dragon-blooded), so recruiting has a collection side.
retention: Knight class index with secret classes
ideas.why_now: Tycoon / base building is still high confidence at 1.33 despite a 0.21 dip ([🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 46.7K, 🧸 My Small Business 20.7K), and Fantasy / medieval is steady at 1.46 (🍀 Tower Of Luck [1.8] 5.9K, [🐶] +1 Forge Blade Loot 3.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Fantasy tycoons build forges or towers. Here you build people: the students are the upgrades and the collection.

ideas.title: +1 Magnet Pull 🧲
ideas.hook: You are a little scrap robot with a magnet. Every second it gains +1 Pull, dragging in bolts, then car doors, then whole robots from across the junkyard.
core_loop: Stand in the junkyard; your magnet gains +1 Pull every second
Pull in heavier scrap as Pull grows
Bolt scrap onto your body to unlock new robot forms
Rebirth into a bigger junkyard with a pull multiplier
ideas.twist: Players' magnets fight over the same scrap, so the strongest pull steals it mid-air.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action + Robots / mechs is the biggest open gap (score 6.28). +1 stat is at 2.39 (up 0.28; [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 36.3K) and Robots / mechs is at 2.09 ([x2💵] Steel Fighters 18.8K, RoChess! 9.7K), though it slipped 0.29 this week.
ideas.differentiator: Robot +1 games grow arms or height. Here the stat is a pull radius, so the world around you changes as it grows.

ideas.title: Ragdoll Bowling 🎳
ideas.hook: You are the bowling ball. Launch your ragdoll down the lane into pins that get bigger every round, until you are knocking over giant pins the size of houses.
core_loop: Pick your launch angle and power
Ragdoll down the lane and crash into the pins
Score by pins toppled; strikes pay double
Upgrade weight and spin; unlock giant lanes
ideas.twist: Up to 6 players launch at once, and you can knock each other off line for steals.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.42, up 0.27 ([🎃] Throw Food For Animals 129.7K, Cat Battles 🐾 15.5K); Physics Sim is at 2.10 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 31.1K, [🎃] Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 23.0K); Giant / huge is up 0.88 to 1.70. Low poly art is rising at 2.23.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are sandboxes. This gives the ragdoll a scored goal and a clear round structure.

ideas.title: Surf the Avalanche 🏂
ideas.hook: An avalanche breaks loose at the top of the mountain. Ride the front of the snow wave on a board, dodging trees and cabins, and grab frozen pets out of ice blocks on the way down.
core_loop: The avalanche starts; drop in ahead of it
Steer around trees, rocks and cabins
Smash ice blocks to free frozen pets for your index
Reach the valley to bank pets; upgrade board and steering
ideas.twist: Fall behind and the snow buries you, but stay too far ahead and you miss the pets in the wave's path.
retention: Frozen pet index with secret pets
ideas.why_now: Escape / run jumped 0.81 to 1.42 ([🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 45.7K), Ice / fire / elements is up 0.12 to 1.39 (Firefighting Sim 🚒 9.4K) and linear courses lead at 2.17 (DONT SPLASH 81.5K). Disaster / weather is up 0.96 but low confidence ([☢️UPD] Create A Disaster💥 6.9K), so it is only flavour here.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Outrun games put the hazard behind you. Here you ride on top of it, and the reward sits right in its path.

ideas.title: Doodle a Dragon 🐉
ideas.hook: Draw a dragon on a canvas and it comes to life. Wing size, tail length and colours you draw set its speed, power and element, then it fights other players' dragons.
core_loop: Draw your dragon on the canvas
It hatches with stats based on the drawing
Fight other dragons in a quick arena round
Win ink colours and stickers to draw stronger dragons
ideas.twist: Colours are elements: red ink breathes fire, blue freezes, so the drawing is the build.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.90 but down 0.42 this week (Backseat Rally 24.6K, Paint and Hide! 🎨 13.9K), so this is a small build. Fantasy / medieval is steady at 1.46 (🍀 Tower Of Luck [1.8] 5.9K).
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games are judged by votes. Here the drawing becomes a fighter, so how you draw decides who wins.
